title: web server's measure-only proof plants its own breach
intention: web server's measure-only proof shows the encapsulation sieve can see by planting one breach in a scratch tree, not by needing a breach somewhere in the live repo.
why: akienasus_cc_0 measured 2026-11-16 (149b's PROVEME refusal, q105) that the sieve found 2 breaches at origin/main@1d490ca18 (04:40) and 0 now, with no sieve change since 05:00: learning_block's and windowless_spawn's were fixed by d7729b310 and 3e62b55b5. A not-blind guard of bool(breaches) over the live repo therefore reds the day the tree comes clean. test_no_breach_from_web_server_lands_on_librarian_or_harbor is one of those guards.
traces_to: Law 8 and Law 9: a proof whose green needs the world to stay dirty is one a correct world fails, so it measures the world, not the component.
how: In each of cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_web_server_proofs_measure_only_the_web_server.py: add test_the_sieve_names_a_planted_breach, which builds a scratch tree with charters at the component and its target and one planted.py importing the target, asks encapsulation_breaches over it through inspect_wire, and checks the sieve returns exactly that row (file, line 1, source, target). It runs first in the proof's teeth. The live tooth drops 'and bool(breaches)' and keeps 'not mine'. This is the pattern in cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_bus_client_proofs_measure_only_bus_client.py:49-62.

clauses.claim: in cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_web_server_proofs_measure_only_the_web_server.py, over a scratch tree with one planted import from cairn/devices/web_server into cairn/devices/librarian, the sieve returns exactly that row: planted.py, line 1, source cairn/devices/web_server, target cairn/devices/librarian

in cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_web_server_proofs_measure_only_the_web_server.py, test_no_breach_from_web_server_lands_on_librarian_or_harbor passes over the clean live tree with 0 breaches elsewhere; red on origin/main@8e6751fd5, which requires a breach elsewhere

decisions.text: D1: each proof file plants its own breach in a scratch tree in test_the_sieve_names_a_planted_breach, run first; the fixture stays inside this component's proofs (RULE 1), with no shared helper.
D2: the live tooth's guard becomes 'not mine' (or 'not rows'), and PROVES gains this ticket's clauses beside the standing ones.
